_comment: How the plan reader talks to the model. DATA, not Kotlin constants — the model id in
particular, because both Llama 4 vision models were shut down mid-2026 (Scout on 17 July,
twelve days before this feature was designed) and any code written from prior knowledge would
have failed on its first call. A retired model must be a config edit, not a release.
PROVIDER: OpenRouter (one door to OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models; same OpenAI-shaped
API the app already spoke to Groq). Chosen 4 Aug 2026 after two measured head-to-heads over
seven real sheets, two runs each — tools/scan-eval/READER-CANDIDATES.md is the scoreboard.
model: openai/gpt-5.6-luna — the value winner. Beats the previous reader (qwen3.6 on Groq)
on every sheet, best of all six candidates on the client's tower plan, immune to branded
pages, ~Rs 0.09 a scan measured (the old reader cost Rs 0.21 and lost rooms).
escalationModel: google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview — the quality king, and the ONLY candidate
that reads the straight-overhead furnished-render class (plan-007) the triage otherwise
refuses. Called once, only when the primary's reply classifies the image as not-2D, so a
genuine photo-of-a-dog still refuses and a furnished plan gets its second opinion
(~Rs 1.4 when it fires; rare).
reasoningEffort is absent on purpose: luna spends ~350 hidden reasoning tokens a scan and
needs no cap; the old Groq-specific 'none' lever does not apply on OpenRouter.
The prompt lives in its own file so it diffs as prose. Same prompt, same 1400px/q88
downscale as every measured run — changing the words invalidates the numbers. Prompt
tuning is a deliberate, re-measured step, never a tweak.
prompt v4 (4 Aug 2026): adds the 'building' page box so the on-photo tint can compose
room boxes onto the page. Re-measured, not tweaked: 35 approved scans over the corpus -
same room lists, same printed-size capture on every sheet with a v3 recording, and the
tint centre error on the truth sheets fell from 0.17-0.28 to 0.007-0.033 of the page.
prompt v5 (5 Aug 2026): the 2D/3D question becomes the CAMERA ANGLE and nothing else, and
the reader now reports its rooms even when it answers 3D_RENDER. v4 described a 3D render
by its STYLING ('often with furniture, shadows'), so both models refused straight-overhead
furnished renders - a flat, fully-dimensioned, perfectly readable class. It blocked the
owner's own plan on BOTH models and the escalation could not save him. Re-measured over the
corpus - plan doc 3u carries the numbers.
prompt v6 (23 Aug 2026): the camera question is asked about THE ONE DRAWING BEING MEASURED,
not about the sheet. v5 asked about 'the image', so a sheet carrying a big showcase render
BESIDE a clean 2D plan came back as 3D_RENDER and the whole sheet was refused - even though
the reader had already boxed the flat plan and read all fifteen of its rooms with their
printed sizes. That is a common builder marketing layout. Re-measured over the corpus.
readsPerScan 2 (19 Sep 2026, owner's decision): the SAME photograph is read twice and the
fuller answer kept. Measured on two paid scans of the owner's own flat - identical JPEG,
identical model, identical prompt - one read returned 20 rooms including four balconies and
the other returned 14 rooms and no balconies at all. The thin read had silently dropped his
balconies, his lift lobby and his utility, and nothing in its reply admitted it: it looked
exactly as confident as the full one. A room that never arrives cannot be corrected on the
check-what-we-read screen, because it is not on the screen - so the engine scores a home
missing a quarter of itself.
This DOUBLES the cost of a scan, from about 8 paise to about 16. That was the owner's call,
made with the number in front of him. Set it back to 1 to restore the old behaviour - it is a
config edit, no release. The two reads run concurrently, so the user waits for the slower one
and not for both. See GroqWire.fullerOf for how the winner is chosen.
